questionLoadXBRLQuestion.label: How can I upload a file to generate the XBRL?
questionLoadXBRLAnswer.label:
Use the button located above the main table on the home page. You can click the button to choose the file or drag and drop the file onto the button area, which starts the full XBRL Lite flow.

Excel files must follow this naming convention: [Entity]_[Module]_[Domain]_[YYYYMM]_[Additional_information].xlsx
questionLoadImportLogsQuestion.label: How can I view the informational messages from the import process in XBRL Lite?
questionLoadImportLogsAnswer.label:
In the main table on the home page, click the button in the third-to-last column of the row for the module you want to inspect. This opens a table with the informational messages for that module’s import process.

To close that table, click the same button again.
questionLoadValidatedRulesQuestion.label: How can I view the validated rules in XBRL Lite?
questionLoadValidatedRulesAnswer.label:
In the main table on the home page, click the button in the second-to-last column of the row for the module you want to inspect. This displays the table with the rules that were validated.

To close the rules table, click the same button again.
questionLoadGenerationLogsQuestion.label: How can I view the informational messages from the generation process in XBRL Lite?
questionLoadGenerationLogsAnswer.label:
In the main table on the home page, click the button in the last column of the row for the module you want to inspect. This opens a table with the informational messages for that module’s generation process.

To close the messages table, click the same button again.
questionLoadFilterModuleMainTableQuestio: How can I filter the modules shown on the home page by a specific module?
In the filter bar above the main table on the home page, there is a “Module” selector. 

Click it and choose the desired module to show only the executions performed with that module in the main table.
questionLoadFilterReferenceDateMainTable: How can I filter the modules on the home page by a specific reference date?

In the filter bar above the main table on the home page, there are two selectors—“Year” and “Month”.

Click “Year” and pick the desired year to show only executions whose reference date matches that year.

Click “Month” and pick the desired month to show only executions whose reference date matches that month.

Selecting both Year and Month applies both criteria, showing only executions whose reference date matches the chosen year and month.
questionLoadCaptionIconsMainTableQuestio: What do the symbols shown in the first three columns mean (Import Status, Validation Status and Generation Status)?
questionLoadChangeLanguageQuestion.label: How can I change XBRL Lite’s language?
questionLoadChangeLanguageAnswer.label:
In the top-right corner, there is a button showing the currently selected language.

To change the language, click that button and choose the desired option.
questionLoadPermitedFilesQuestion.label: Which documents should I use to generate the XBRL?
questionLoadPermitedFilesAnswer.label: You should use documents that comply with the EBA taxonomy—that is, files prepared from the relevant templates and in accordance with the applicable Implementing Technical Standards (ITS).
questionLoadDownloadTemplatesPageQuestio: Where can I download the empty templates to generate the XBRL?
If you do not have an empty template that complies with the Implementing Technical Standards (ITS), you can obtain one via XBRL Lite. In the top-right corner, click the “Usage Templates” button (to the left of the “F.A.Q” button). You will be redirected to a page with a table listing the available templates for download.
questionLoadFilterModuleTemplateTableQue: How can I filter the templates on the “Usage Templates” page by a specific module?
questionLoadFilterModuleTemplateTableAns: In the filter bar above the templates table, there is an “All Modules” selector. Click it and choose a module to show only the templates available for download for that module. You can combine multiple filters simultaneously, such as module, reference date, and version.
questionLoadFilterBeginDateTemplateTable: How can I filter the templates on the “Usage Templates” page by a specific date?

In the filter bar above the templates table, there are two selectors—“Year” and “Month”. Click “Year” and select the desired year to show only the templates available for download whose start date matches that year. Click “Month” and select the desired month to show only the templates available for download whose start date matches that month. You can combine multiple filters simultaneously, such as module, reference date, and version.
questionLoadFilterVersionTemplateTableQu: How can I filter the templates on the “Usage Templates” page by a specific version?
questionLoadFilterVersionTemplateTableAn: In the filter bar above the templates table, there is a “Version” selector. Click it and choose the desired version to show only the templates available for download that match that version. You can combine multiple filters simultaneously, such as module, reference date, and version.
questionLoadDownloadTemplateButtonQuesti: How can I download the desired template?
questionLoadDownloadTemplateButtonAnswer: On the “Usage Templates” page, click the button in the last column of the row for the template you wish to download. The download will start automatically to your computer.
questionLoadReturnMainPageQuestion.label: After opening the “Usage Templates” page, how can I return to the home page?
questionLoadReturnMainPageAnswer.label: To return to the home page, click the Neyond logo in the top-left corner.
